target_customer: Institutional investors and public equity research teams
problem: Analysts spend hours reading SEC filings, earnings transcripts and footnotes. Fintool applies LLMs to those documents to answer questions and surface insights faster than manual search.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI financial research

founders.name: Nicolas Bustamante
previous_startups: Doctrine (legal search, led as CEO for seven years, acquired by Summit Partners in 2023)
founders.background_notes: Earlier listings describe the company as Blocktool, a no-code financial data connector, before the financial copilot focus.

founders.name: Edouard Godfrey
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder and CTO on Menlo Ventures' page. No further background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval and question answering over long SEC filings and transcripts using GPT-class models was feasible for a small team in 2023, but accuracy on financial documents needed careful engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third party foundation models and public filings, so copying the wedge was easy. Differentiation depended on speed of product iteration and accuracy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft acquired the team in April 2026 to bring financial agents into its Office product group.

market_need_then: Institutional investors pay heavily for research tooling and document analysis. The release of ChatGPT in late 2022 opened a clear opening for LLM based reading of financial filings.

branding.domain_note: Uses fintool.com. Acquisition history of the domain not found. The site redirected to a Microsoft 365 page after the acquisition.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benchmark driven, with press pages claiming accuracy wins over analysts.

brand_strength.rationale: Only listings and comparison pages mention the brand. No sources show community, merch or press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: Blocktool, a no-code tool connecting finance software data
pivots.to: Fintool, an LLM financial research copilot

outcome_analysis: Fintool rode the 2023 LLM wave by pointing models at SEC filings and transcripts, backed by a founder with prior experience selling a document search company. It raised a Menlo seed in 2025 and was acquired by Microsoft in April 2026, apparently as a team and product acquisition with undisclosed terms.
notes: Company site now redirects to a Microsoft page. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Unverified single source figures: CB Insights lists about 7.24M across three rounds including 6.74M dated 2026-01, and VCBacked lists a 500K pre-seed around 2023-04. Menlo's page says founded 2024 while YC says 2023. Acquisition date taken from secondary press, primary announcement not seen.
